title_vi: Gõ google.com vào trình duyệt thì chuyện gì xảy ra?

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches provider tree OID. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Bước dựng trang được giải thích chi tiết ở bài trình duyệt dựng trang.
Bài kế tiếp đi sâu vào các phần của URL và thông điệp HTTP.

claims.evidence: MDN pages read from a local clone of mdn/content; DNS server types and layered DNS caching come from the source.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: DNS is a hierarchical and decentralized naming system that maps names to IP addresses.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: TCP sets up a connection with a three-way handshake of SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK; TLS is a protocol for secure communication across a network.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable). (TLS: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/TLS)

claims.claim_vi: The HTTP cache stores a response and reuses it for later requests without going to the origin server.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: HTTP/1.x has short-lived connections and persistent connections, so a connection can serve more than one request.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: HSTS tells browsers a site must only be accessed over HTTPS and that later HTTP attempts are upgraded automatically.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: HTTP/3 runs over QUIC instead of a single TCP connection.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: The DNS lookup passes through root, TLD and authoritative servers and results are cached in browser, OS, local network and ISP layers.
claims.verified_by: Carried from the source as general description; not independently checked.

design_notes_vi: Sáu thẻ nối nhau; ghi chú nói đây là đường chính. Thêm bước TLS mà bài nguồn bỏ qua. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source describes only the TCP three-way handshake of HTTP/1.1 and never mentions TLS; the lesson adds the TLS step for HTTPS and the shortcuts (cache hit, reused connection, QUIC).
Source folds JavaScript execution and rendering into steps 6-7; the lesson keeps one 'dựng trang' step and points to the dedicated rendering lesson.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
